svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Procedure pending the Rev U re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev U architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
All 8 nodes interconnect on CAN FD, 1553, RS-485, and Ethernet, 5 kV isolated.
Commo joins CAN FD / RS-485 / 1553C only (no Ethernet).
Each nacelle EDF is PID-controlled by two different SBCs; any FC node can take any EDF.
Bus electrical rules: avionics/AGENTS.md and each board's .md.
